values.description: Observables to enrich, any mix of types. At most 100 are looked up; values from position 100 on are returned in skipped with reason request_limit. Defanged input (evil[.]com, hxxp://) is accepted and normalised.

types.description: Optional per-value type hint, same length as values. One of cve, domain, ip, url, md5, sha1, sha256, or an empty string for none. A hint never overrides a safety skip; an unknown hint is reported and ignored.

detail.description: compact returns one citation per hit; full returns every citation, and each citation's source sentence if the token holds the context scope.

since.description: Ignore report days before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).
